name: Anaheim Feet 2019
information:
* The only event at this competiton is 3x3x3 With Feet. Hence, this is also the main event.
* The purpose of this competition is to give competitors one last chace to compete in the 3x3x3 With Feet event if it is to be removed in 2020.
* **Important:** The competition is not being held in the high school.  It is being held in a private residance in the neighborhood next to the high school.  The address and parking instructions will be emailed to competitors the week before the competition.
